knownGood: 7 widget HTML + dashboard script syntax passed
90/90 Shared Taxa package files match checksums
limitations: Direct file:// Chromium navigation blocked in audit environment
Actual Windows folder sync and persistence not tested
Artwork checksum validation is not scientific/cultural accuracy review
Concept proposals are not implemented code

issues.title: Artwork approval can bypass on-screen safeguards via imported JSON
issues.details: The review checkbox rejects a draft, but importState() copies approved:true into state.subject without checking phase, image quality or provenance. A prepared JSON can therefore mark an unreviewed collage crop approved.
issues.acceptance: Use a single guarded approveSubject() pathway for form changes, imports and saved-HTML restoration; reject approval unless full-resolution asset, rights, and human review are recorded.
issues.evidence: MASTER_DASHBOARD_v1.18.html :: importState() versus change handler approval check

issues.title: Previously approved artwork can be moved back to draft without clearing approval
issues.details: The phase select is editable independently, and the draft guard runs only when the approved checkbox is changed to true. Switching an approved review to draft can leave a contradictory approved:true state.
issues.acceptance: Validate both phase and approved together on every mutation; migrate contradictory saved states and show an audit warning.
issues.evidence: MASTER_DASHBOARD_v1.18.html :: setField(), change handler subject phase

issues.title: Launcher HTML import does not transport external artwork directories
issues.details: The direct HTML picker accepts HTML and importFiles classifies selected filenames; external artwork assets are not included with a single imported HTML document. Standalone and bundle editions require different handling.
issues.acceptance: Provide import-mode detection and a readiness warning; recommend standalone HTML for launcher imports or implement a verified asset-bundle copying flow.
issues.evidence: widgets/Widget_Launcher_v1.12.html :: file-input accept=.html, importFiles(); README launcher-ready guidance

issues.title: Nested full-content ZIP duplicates a large fraction of the distribution
issues.details: The dashboard folder includes downloads/Atlas_Widgets_Full_Content_v1.18.zip (~31.9 MB), which is itself stored inside the ~63.7 MB top-level package. This increases download/archive size and complicates identifying the canonical package.
issues.acceptance: Choose a single canonical full release artifact; for the in-dashboard download, generate a nonrecursive export or document the nested bundle purpose and verify both.

issues.title: Reduced-motion support is inconsistent with the rest of the atlas family
issues.details: Tree of Life includes CSS transitions but no prefers-reduced-motion override, unlike the other six current HTML files. Animation impact is likely modest, but shared accessibility behavior is inconsistent.
issues.acceptance: Add a shared prefers-reduced-motion media rule and keyboard/focus regression checks while retaining intended static transitions.
issues.evidence: widgets/Tree_of_Life_Atlas_v1.14.html :: two transition rules, zero prefers-reduced-motion clauses

issues.title: Suggestion-to-issue action copies text but does not create a linked backlog item
issues.details: The “Copy proposal as backlog note” control invokes clipboard copy only. Suggestions and issues have no persistent cross-reference or automatic status linkage.
issues.acceptance: Add Convert to issue and Related goal / issue IDs, with duplicate detection and traceable acceptance criteria.

issues.title: Review decisions are not integrated with release manifests and binaries
issues.details: The dashboard updates its internal art-review status but does not change asset manifest SHA-256, provenance, local image files or standalone HTML artwork. The existing release pipeline remains manual.
issues.acceptance: Build a guarded staging queue with source/license check, checksum generation, manifest diff and standalone/bundle parity tests before promotion.
issues.evidence: MASTER_DASHBOARD_v1.18.html :: setField() and exports; README artwork workflow

issues.title: Automated release behavior checks do not yet cover full Windows file sync and storage
issues.details: Script and inline browser smoke checks exist, but folder permissions, persisted IndexedDB data, cross-version restart behavior and local file integration have not been verified on Windows.
issues.acceptance: Execute a repeatable Windows Edge/Chrome QA matrix and attach a dated pass/fail log for launcher import, offline reopen, and dataset/art persistence.
issues.evidence: README.md :: Review limitations; Widget Launcher v1.12 source

issues.title: Goal comparisons cover only three of six atlas widgets
issues.details: The current dashboard includes generated-versus-actual comparisons for Deep Time, Brain, and Mythology. Tree of Life, Muscle, Emergence and launcher have no equivalent approved visual target and before/current side-by-side record.
issues.acceptance: Capture comparable actual screenshots for every widget, document subject-specific design criteria and add a mockup approval workflow for the remaining four.
issues.evidence: data/project_catalog_v1.18.json :: comparisonEmbeds keys deep/brain/myth; qa screenshots

issues.title: Canonical interval and Deep Time interval totals are not explicitly distinguished in dashboard metrics
issues.details: Shared Taxa identifies 173 canonical intervals while Deep Time currently indexes 172 HTML intervals. Both counts are valid for different scopes, but the interface can appear contradictory.
issues.acceptance: Label counts as 173 canonical Shared Taxa intervals versus 172 Deep Time indexed intervals and link to the mapping/coverage explanation.

issues.title: Checksums validate assets but do not validate scientific or cultural interpretation
issues.details: All 538 artwork and 90 Shared Taxa file hashes match package manifests. Hash correctness only proves bytes match; visual accuracy and 57 source ambiguities remain separate review tasks.
issues.acceptance: Add evidence-grade review fields and subject expert sign-off distinct from checksum validation; do not use a verified hash as an accuracy badge.

issues.title: Artwork source rights and final approval can be represented only as free-form state
issues.details: Production artwork manifests have disclosure/review fields, but the integrated dashboard can mark assessment “approved” without a structured source URL, license, or scientist/cultural reviewer; release gating is not enforced.
issues.acceptance: Require provenance, license/permission, subject-review identity and timestamp before allowing approved-for-release status.

issues.title: Goal, issue and improvement status updates can drift independently
issues.details: 84 goals, 12 baseline issues and 11 suggestions are distinct mutable registers with no stable dependency links or automatic acceptance-test closure when related work completes.
issues.acceptance: Attach structured related IDs and per-release change evidence; offer a linked issue → proposal → goal detail and closure checklist.

issues.title: Keyboard, contrast and responsive coverage is not maintained as a uniform regression matrix
issues.details: All seven pages rendered in a Chromium smoke check; this does not prove keyboard-only navigation, dialogs/focus traps, screen readers or all viewport breakpoints across all flows.
issues.acceptance: Run axe/keyboard/contrast and 320/390/768/1440 responsive checks per release, recording exceptions by widget.
issues.evidence: QA source checks; widget HTML aria-label and motion styles

issues.title: Full decisions import accepts arbitrary review states without schema validation
issues.details: The imported master JSON is merged into mutable review/goal/issue state and custom arrays without a schema check for permitted status values, approved flags, reference IDs or contradiction.
issues.acceptance: Validate import against a versioned JSON schema; preserve unknown fields in quarantine and preview a diff before applying changes.

issues.title: Path verification cannot establish local file existence automatically under file://
issues.details: The UI uses HTTP HEAD when served and a folder picker when local, so links remain Not verified in file:// until a manual directory scan. This is expected browser behavior but can be mistaken for missing assets.
issues.acceptance: Make offline mode explicit and add a one-click guided directory-check wizard with separate states for blocked/unverified/missing.

suggestions.title: One unified audit-to-release triage panel
suggestions.detail: Turn scan findings into linked issue, acceptance check, proposed improvement and test evidence, not disconnected status cards.
suggestions.impact: Fewer forgotten fixes; clearer release readiness

suggestions.title: Preflight bundled-artwork compatibility before syncing
suggestions.detail: Detect whether imported HTML contains local asset references and confirm a self-contained build or all adjacent files exist before marking ready.
suggestions.impact: Avoid invisible images after local launcher import

suggestions.title: Add an evidence-backed selected-clade focus panel
suggestions.detail: Retain the existing hierarchy, but show curated organism visual, dated lineage summary and source link next to the active selection.
suggestions.impact: More useful organism exploration and shared family styling

suggestions.title: Clear selected muscle anatomy and exercise context
suggestions.detail: Keep muscle labels/navigation but provide a consistent selected-muscle highlight and a compact exercise-role card, with actual exercise data only.
suggestions.impact: Improved anatomical learning and exercise context

suggestions.title: Add evidence-and-scale comparison for the active emergence level
suggestions.detail: Use the existing level model to link its components, interactions, scale ranges and uncertainties in a compact network-evidence view.
suggestions.impact: Evidence-centered exploration rather than unsupported quantification

suggestions.title: Explain 172 vs 173 interval scope through a mapping view
suggestions.detail: Show canonical Shared Taxa interval coverage beside Deep Time UI interval IDs and explain intentionally nonmatching scope.
suggestions.impact: Clarifies dependencies and reduces count confusion

suggestions.title: Use a gated artwork promotion and manifest-diff wizard
suggestions.detail: After human approval, show license provenance, checksum, affected thumbnails and exact standalone/bundle rebuild list before promotion.
suggestions.impact: Safer art review with reproducible releases

suggestions.title: Portable project-state snapshots with previewable diff
suggestions.detail: Offer versioned import validation, review-only changes, audit logs and merge choices before replacing existing approval/checklist states.
suggestions.impact: Prevent silent overwrites and incompatible decisions

suggestions.title: Add a coordinate-provenance route for future true depth
suggestions.detail: Keep existing estimated-depth mode, but prepare a separate registered model path for anatomical 3D coordinates and view-specific overlays.
suggestions.impact: Higher depth fidelity without false precision

suggestions.title: Separate generated narrative portraits from documented historical artwork
suggestions.detail: Add figure-level Source artwork tab with credit, object date, museum/license and external records rather than implying modern art is ancient.

suggestions.title: Standard keyboard, reduced-motion and visual-contrast test plan
suggestions.detail: Apply the same focus, motion and popup keyboard handling to all six atlases and launcher; save a per-version acceptance log.
suggestions.impact: More reliable and accessible shared components

suggestions.title: One-click release verification report
suggestions.detail: Generate a read-only local audit of linked files, asset hashes, application syntax, version buttons, comparison coverage and data dependencies.
suggestions.impact: Clear release gates and fewer regressions

suggestions.title: Link interval artwork to traceable paleomaps and representative life
suggestions.detail: Add verified interval-specific continents/paleomap assets and dated taxon references with citations and exclusions where evidence is weak.

suggestions.title: Show authoritative package and asset health per widget
suggestions.detail: On each launcher card, display actual linked HTML version, dataset dependency, image bundle type, last validation and sync errors.
